outcome: stress urinary incontinence (SUI) 1 year after delivery
cohort: The study included 172 multiparous women who gave birth from January 2016 to March 2018 in Peking University Third Hospital.
finding: For multiparous women, SUI after the first delivery, gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), and age >= 35 years were identified as independent risk factors for SUI 1 year after delivery.
mod_finding: Univariate analysis indicated that birth exclusively by vaginal delivery increased the risk for SUI 1 year after delivery.
